provenance.source: NECB 2020 Tables 4.2.3.1.-A..-E via the building-codes MCP (necb:2020). 2025 verified IDENTICAL by DIRECT value-for-value diff of all five tables, 2026-08-02 (D-61 amendment; the only differences are unicode m²-vs-m2 cosmetics inside 2025 cells) — the earlier 'similarity 0.978' justification ran through the edition mapper hbix's table audit showed cannot connect renamed tables, and is superseded. provenance.notes: RE-VERIFIED 2026-08-02 against the post-hbix-fix extraction (D-61): all values match the corrected printed table exactly. Zone 0 has no allowances anywhere. Table -C rows other than facades apply at a single value wherever permitted (zones 1/2-4 per the code text); the PDF extraction merges those cells — values below transcribed with their applicable zones.

lighting_zones.0: Undeveloped areas within national/provincial/territorial parks, forest land, rural and other undeveloped areas
lighting_zones.1: Developed areas within national/provincial/territorial parks, and rural areas
lighting_zones.2: Residential zoning, neighbourhood business districts, light industrial with limited nighttime use, residential mixed-use

tradable.application: Walkways >= 3 m wide, plaza and special feature areas
Outdoor sales open areas (incl. vehicle sales lots)
Street frontage for vehicle sales lots (in addition to open area)

non_tradable.application: Entrances/gatehouse inspection stations at guarded facilities
Loading areas for emergency service vehicles
Parking near 24-hour retail entrances (per main entry)
